description_en: Queries the Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) settings of a PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 查询PolarDB引擎集群的TDE设置详情
name: DescribeDBClusterTDE

AutomaticRotation.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic key rotation is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled.
This parameter is returned only when the database engine is PostgreSQL-compatible or Oracle-syntax-compatible
AutomaticRotation.description_zh:
是否允许了密钥自动轮转，取值：

Enabled：允许
Disabled：不允许
仅当数据库引擎为PostgreSQL兼容或Oracle语法兼容时，返回该参数

EncryptNewTables.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic encryption of all newly created tables is enabled. Valid values:

ON: Enabled.

OFF: Disabled.
This parameter is returned only when the database engine is MySQL-compatible
EncryptNewTables.description_zh:
是否开启自动加密所有新建的表。取值：

ON：开启

OFF：关闭
仅当数据库引擎为MySQL兼容时，返回该参数

EncryptionKeyStatus.description_en:
The status of the key. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
EncryptionKeyStatus.description_zh:
密钥的状态。返回值：
Enabled：启用。
Disabled：未启用

RotationInterval.description_en:
The automatic key rotation interval configured in Key Management Service (KMS). If no automatic key rotation interval is configured, 0 s is returned. Unit: s.

For example, if the rotation interval is 7 days, 604800 s is returned.

This parameter is returned only when the database engine is PostgreSQL-compatible or Oracle-syntax-compatible and the value of AutomaticRotation is Enabled
RotationInterval.description_zh:
在KMS设置的密钥自动轮转周期。若未设置密钥自动轮转周期，则返回0 s。单位：s。

例如：轮转周期为7 天时，返回604800 s。

仅当数据库引擎为PostgreSQL兼容或Oracle语法兼容，且AutomaticRotation取值为Enabled时，返回该参数

TDERegion.description_en: The region where the TDE key resides

TDEStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether TDE is enabled. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
TDEStatus.description_zh:
是否开通TDE加密，取值：
Enabled：开通
Disabled：关闭
